instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. On an outdoor bridge with a metal railing, two men stand side-by-side against a soft-focus urban background. On the left, the Black man in the light blue button-down shirt and jeans (R1) leans against the railing, holding a white coffee cup and looking towards his companion. On the right, the fair-skinned man in the teal t-shirt and dark jeans (R2) also leans on the railing, holding a coffee cup and looking ahead. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight, creating a relaxed and casual atmosphere.
